Method of Attack: Data wiper that pretends to be ransomware by replacing file contents with an anti-Israel message

Modular malware with 5 executables: IsraBye.exe (launcher and wiper), Cry.exe (changes desktop wallpaper), Cur.exe (attaches image to mouse cursor), Lock.exe (terminates certain processes, launches Index.exe, copies IsraBye.exe as ClickMe.exe to spread malware), Index.exe (displays lock screen and plays a wav file)
Destroys file contents rather than encrypting
Spreads by copying itself as ClickMe.exe to root of other drives
Terminates process monitoring tools (procexp64, ProcessHacker, taskmgr, procexp, xns5)
Impacted Systems: All attached drives on infected Windows systems
Indicators of Compromise: Files named ClickMe.exe in root of drives
Presence of IsraBye.exe and its extracted executables Cry.exe, Cur.exe, Lock.exe, Index.exe
